description:
LA ARTIST HOUSE - READ MY REVIEWS!

(If this spot is booked, send a message, I may have other spots available in the same house!)

A Shared-Room; Co-Living space in a Dorm-Style, Luxury Home.
A beautiful neighborhood, near gorgeous parks & tennis courts.

A safe place to call home while learning LA, going to classes & making new friends - & those new friends can be the new roommates you meet when you move in.

Resort fee of $52.06 per night collected by hotel.

Spread out and rock out in our most spacious standard room. One king bed, a cushy lounge chair, killer custom mural, and fresh interiors set the stage for a good time, while a mini fridge, luxury toiletries, and 55” flatscreen TV ensure you have everything you need. The approximately 300-square-foot room also features an oversized desk for when you want to plug in and spin your own beats in the comfort of your own star-dusted space.

Discover the magic of Maui from this amazing harborfront property! This is the ideal place to start your unforgettable island adventure. Enjoy the sun and the sea at the gorgeous Ho'aloha Park Beach or Paukukalo Beach, just minutes away. Explore the scenic hiking trails and viewpoints at Iao Valley State Park. Find great restaurants and shopping options nearby. This is the perfect spot for a thrilling Maui getaway!

This large double room, is in a 4 bedroom flat just 15 mins walk to Bermondsey underground station.
Room has two double beds, wardobe, desk with chair . Room also has a private balcony.

Maximum for 3 people only

All the rooms in the flat are for airbnb guests and bathroom and kitchen has to be shared with them.

Tower Bridge is only 20 mins walk from the flat. London eye, Buckingham palace, big ben, Borough market , London Bridge are all just 5-15 mins away by underground train.

*Ask about possible discounts for your stay!*

A quiet oasis tucked away , yet only blocks from shopping, restaurants, and movie theaters. Bonus are the beaches, hiking, biking, and horseback riding trails within close proximity & Kona Country Club, which features a championship golf course. This is a beautiful spot to satisfy your fun-filled Hawaiian vacation.Tour Mountain Thunder Coffee Plantation, Visit Hawaii Volcanoes National Park & Explore Kaloko-Honokohau National Park.
Contact us for last-minute reservations. This ground floor 2-bedroom, 2-bath Maui vacation rental is decorated with a stylish tropical theme with hues of green and blue.

** Please MESSAGE ME before booking!
Deals available

•1 bed/bath in shared room - West LA area - 90025;
• Room May be shared with male or female (separation available);
• Kitchen, living room available and for common use;
• Did we hear UCLA? Bus is down the street for you to hop on!
• SANTA MONICA BEACH is easily reachable by comfortably taking a ride on the famous BUS 1, one block down the street;
• What's your favorite cuisine? We have it all down the street!

R u ready to enjoy ur stay?!

Nestled in the heart of the city that never sleeps, our hotel offers the perfect base for exploring the iconic attractions that define the vibrancy of the Big Apple. Conveniently located near Newark Liberty International Airport and just a short distance from One World Trade Center. Experience the mesmerizing Times Square, mere moments from our hotel's doorstep. Discover iconic landmarks like Rockefeller Center and the Empire State Building, or wander through enchanting Central Park pathways.

Private room with double bed in a two floor family house.

Walking distance to cafe, restaurants, shops, pubs, and some lovely forest walks.

0.4 mile to Wood Street Station. From which Liverpool Street station is 30 minutes.

1.2 mile to Walthamstow Central station. From which Oxford Circus/Street is 40 minutes.

With the stunning white sands of Hapuna Beach close at hand, the famed Kona coffee orchards and many more attractions of the island's beautiful Up Country, Paniolo Greens located on the Big Island of Hawaii's Kohala Coast, offers fully furnished villas, beautiful views, outdoor pool and a fitness centre.

Paniolo offers access to many restaurants and popular sites, including a number of top-rated golf courses. Volcano National Park, Waipio Valley and the North Shore are a short distance away.

This bright and trendy 2 bedroom/2 bath is perfect for a great visit to LA whether you’re here for fun or business. The space is perfectly decorated and will make you feel at home the moment you walk through the door. You'll appreciate the 65 inch smart TV in the living room, fully-equipped kitchen, A/C in each room and additional smart TV in the master bedroom. It also comes with free WiFi , free parking in the garage for a regular sized vehicle, and great vibes to ensure a perfect trip to LA!

The flat is a hidden gem in the heart of South Norwood, conveniently located between Crystal Palace and Thornton Heath.
Kick back and relax in this calm, clean space which has been transformed into a stylish urban retreat.
This property offers the perfect blend of convenience and comfort well suited for a group of friends, couples, small families, business contractors to be used for few days, weekend getaway, away football matches and or for long stays.

Show up and start living from day one in London with this stylish one bedroom Blueground apartment. You’ll love coming home to this thoughtfully furnished, beautifully designed, and fully-equipped Marylebone home . (ID #LON502)

Newly refurbished 2 double bedroom flat, just opposite Channel 4 TV studios, 5 min walk from St James's Park tube station, Big Ben and Westminster Abbey, 10 min walk from Victoria station; great connections to the rest of London. This cosy apartment is ideal for business or just leisure - plenty of surrounding bars, stands with variety of foods, supermarkets, local restaurants - all in the heart of London to make your stay fabulous!

This house is one of the best guest houses in London. It features a huge modern built kitchen and bathroom with extra space to relax. the rooms are spacious with modern facilities. Its located in central part of London and surrounded by three main line train station and a newly built tube station called Battersea power station. Travelling from the airport and around the city by the public transport is very easy and comfortable.

The luxury property in New York’s very own neighborhood city, Manhattan, is imbued with European-inspired architectural charm. With some of the attractions like Madison Square Garden, the Metropolitan Museum of Art, and the Empire State Building minutes away, this sophisticated Upper West Side property provides comfort and convenience to guests lodging for business or leisure.

Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place in the ❤️ of W&G!
The space
Comfortable lovely 2Beds(1 kings and 1 Queen)&1 full Bath free parking on permit.
Our home Just 12 minutes from Downtown Los Angeles and Old Town Pasadena.convenient stores, near Electric charger station,tons of authentic Asian restaurants/eateries. Nested in a safe and convenient residential neighborhood, a preferred choice for a family retreat or business trip!
We hope you like it!

Show up and start living from day one in Uptown with this sophisticated two bedroom Blueground apartment. You’ll love coming home to this thoughtfully furnished, beautifully designed, and fully-equipped Upper West Side home with stunning views over the city. (ID #NYC868)

Located in Hollywood in one of the nicest neighborhoods in the area.

This Co-living house is right by Los Angles Community College.

Shared Rooms for rent.

College students and working professionals.

Work desk stations for computer set up.

Hulu Live TV, HBO Max and Disney Plus.

Lockable Wardrobe Cabinets in the rooms.

Stay in the heart of hipster Hackney: Broadway Market, London Fields and Shoreditch all on your doorstep!

The light, spacious and well-equipped flat has a large double bedroom, great outdoor space, views over London and a 1GB internet connection for those who need to work.

You'll be at the heart of Kaua’i’s adventure! Swim at golden sand beaches, explore Lihue's vibrant culture, hike breathtaking trails, and savor local cuisine. Proximity to the airport & free shuttle means more time for fun!

This is an ideal hostel for people who are passing through London or spend some time exploring London. The energy and vibe here is friendly, welcoming and peaceful.

Guests who are attracted to stay here are often from diverse backgrounds, relaxed in nature and often very helpful too. As may have seen the location is excellent with effective methods of transport to and from North, South and Central London. There is also a Westfield's within a 10minute walk.

Relax with the family and friends in a peaceful place to stay. Clean, quiet, safe, comfortable and easily accessible place. Just minutes away from Laguardia Airport and buses to the airport. Close to many restaurants and dinning establishments, bars, lounges, laundromat, public transportation, library and many other amenities. Feel at home when your miles away from home. Your tranquility awaits.

Our multi-award winning hostel is located right in the heart of London. With the benefit of having both London Bridge & Borough underground at our doorstep we provide the perfect location to connect you to the rest of the city.

Our famous Belushi’s bar is located below with exclusive daily drink deals & 25% off our awesome menu! We host live DJs, live sports and epic parties and provide free WiFi, a range of modern dorms & private rooms, laundry facilities, a rooftop terrace & a 24h reception.
Explore Beverly Hills with ease: Walk to the famed Rodeo Drive, visit the Museum of Tolerance, and drive to the Los Angeles County Museum of Art and the Getty Center. Attractions abound nearby!

I renovated my flat myself and I’ve poured a lot of love into it & like to think it’s a calm, beautiful & stylish space! The garden is lovely, with the street being very quiet & calm. A 5 min walk to local bakery, butchers, fishmongers, pubs & an array of shops in the beautiful Nunhead village. 10 mins walk from both Nunhead & Queen’s Road Peckham stations, quick links to central. The flat is my home, I have created space for you, there will be some of my personal items there too.

QUEEN SIZED bed; PERFECT for COUPLES! VERY ACCESSIBLE! 4 min walk to the J M G subways lines and 2 Stops away from Manhattan. PRIVATE bedroom in a newly renovated apartment in Williamsburg! Shared bathroom, kitchen & living room with CENTRAL HEAT & AC. Check-in is 12PM until 10PM / check-out is 10AM. **Please note before booking: This is a shared space. You are renting a room, not the entire apartment :) Please no other guests outside of your reservation**

Experience New York City from this spacious, renovated apartment in historic Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn. You’ll find plenty of space to rest and relax. Bed-Stuy is a vibrant, exciting neighborhood, with tons of dining options within walking distance. Or you can hop on the subway and head to Manhattan to explore even more. This is a fully furnished apartment managed by Outpost Club, a premier CoLiving establishment in New York City.

Relax in gold king bedrooms and shared living room, shared kitchen, shared laundry area, and private bathroom.

You will find Starbucks, McDonalds, UFC Gym, Supermarket (Thuan Phat, Hoa Binh, Hawaii, Walmart, Target) w/in 5 mins. 10 mins drive to Costco, Sams, Home Depot, Montebello Mall, LA Fitness, 24-hr Fitness, Hospital, 10 & 60 freeway. Diverse of restaurants w/in 10 mins drive. Bus station located w/in 7 mins walk.
18-30 mins away from downtown LA, Universal, Disneyland.

Discover a gem in Notting Hill! Our exceptional 3-bed, 2-bath duplex offers stunning views over Notting Hill. Situated on a crescent at the top of the hill, this classic building boasts modern interiors and amenities and beautiful light. 2 King and 1 Double bedrooms on the 3rd floor, plus a spacious living area on the 4th floor, ensure comfort and style. The cafes, shops and restaurants of Westbourne Grove and Portobello are within easy walking. Experience a unique retreat in this tranquil haven
